sloka: इमं हि सालं सहित स्त्वया शरो ।न संशयोऽत्रास्ति विदारयिष्यति ।अलं विमर्शेन मम प्रियं ध्रुवं ।कुरुष्व राजात्मज शापितो मया ॥४-११-९२॥।।
transliteration: imaṁ hi sālaṁ sahita stvayā śaro ।na saṁśayo'trāsti vidārayiṣyati ।alaṁ vimarśena mama priyaṁ dhruvaṁ ।kuruṣva rājātmaja śāpito mayā ॥4-11-92॥।।

translations.english: 'It will be enough and my doubt will be cleared. If you can pierce the sala tree with your arrow it will be my pleasure and not a test of your strength.
